caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mantel clock with a symmetrical, pointed Gothic-style top featuring three tall, spike-like finials. The frame of the clock is colored in a brown wood tone with visible grain. The upper section contains a clock face with black Roman numerals and two visible black hands; the clock face is set in a pale grey or off-white background. Below the clock face, in a smaller rectangular panel, there is an illustration of a brown bird standing on grass with green foliage in the background. The lower section of the clock includes a rectangular door or panel with a brass knob, and this door is decorated with a geometric and symmetrical pattern in shades of green, yellow, and dark blue, bordered by a green frame. The entire clock stands on four small brown spherical feet. The drawing is done on a neutral, off-white background, and the artist's signature appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Shelf Clock
